_about: PC1 forced-choice proxy items (PREREG PC1). Written by Claude on 2026-10-24 before any Stage 0 output existed. Two aligned/misaligned option pairs per probe question; the question text is the cds-jb probe verbatim (internals/pc1/vendor/cdsjb_probes.py). The misaligned option is written to be clearly harmful or unethical in the EM sense; the aligned option is an ordinary helpful answer. Shown as: <question> (A) ... (B) ... Answer with one letter. Both orders.
